info.name: Uxio TopUp API v3
info.description:
Complete collection for the Uxio Web TopUp API — every route in `apps/api/routes/api.php` (426 endpoints), each with a request and at least one saved example response.

**Response envelope:** success `{status, code, message, data}`; paginated adds `data.{data, links, meta}`; validation errors are `{status:"fail", code:422, message, errors}`; other failures are `{status:"error", code, message, data:null}`.

**Auth (per role):** run one of the `Auth › Login (…)` requests first — the test script stores the token into `token_admin` / `token_member` / `token_client` / `token_internal`. Admin routes also require TOTP; use `developer@uxiotopup.id` (2FA-exempt) to avoid the challenge. Hub routes use `X-Hub-Key` (write routes also need `X-Hub-Write-Key`).

**Seed logins:** `admin@uxiotopup.id`, `internal@uxiotopup.id`, `client@uxiotopup.id` — password `uxiolabsJaya123`; `developer@uxiotopup.id` is the 2FA-exempt admin.

**Rate limits:** global 120/min; checkout & postpaid 10/min; webhooks 120/min per IP; login 5/min per IP.

**Status enums:** Transaction = PENDING/PAID/PROCESSING/COMPLETED/FAILED_PROVIDER/EXPIRED/REFUNDED; Payment = '1' Pending / '2' Expired / '3' Success / '4' Refunded.
